limits: No wrangler or Miniflare run; the Workers runtime, ROOM and DIRECTORY bindings, SQLite-backed object storage, hibernation, alarms and 101 WebSocket upgrade are unverified
The E tests use in-process fakes, node:sqlite and fake Durable Object state; they do not prove Cloudflare transaction isolation, outbox delivery or global scheduling
The directory is a single global SQLite projection and a potential write bottleneck; no measured load or multi-object throughput is claimed

The room outbox is durable and retried by later requests or alarms, but there is no dedicated background drainer; a permanently failing delivery can leave a room's projection stale until another activity occurs
Directory delivery is eventually consistent; a just-completed room may not appear in discovery or export until its outbox flush succeeds
A provider-deleted account whose room fan-out fails cannot self-retry because the Clerk identity is gone; the durable deletion job requires an operator replay
Archives are privacy-minimised results only and are immutable per code and version; they are not a full audit log or a backup of room state
